# Remove-ZbxUserMacro

## SYNOPSIS

Removes user macros.

## SYNTAX

```
Remove-ZbxUserMacro [-InputObject] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixUserMacro>[]> [-Force] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A user macro is a named value, such as {$APP.PORT}, that items, triggers and other fields refer to; a host or template macro overrides a global one. The Remove-ZbxUserMacro cmdlet deletes the user macros given to -InputObject (names, ids or piped objects) with usermacro.delete, all in one call when the pipeline ends. It asks for confirmation first unless -Confirm:$false or -Force is given, and -WhatIf lists what would be deleted. It writes nothing, and needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Delete one macro of a host

```powershell
Get-ZbxUserMacro -Host 'web-01' | Where-Object Macro -EQ '{$APP.TIMEOUT}' | Remove-ZbxUserMacro -Confirm:$false
Get-ZbxUserMacro -Host 'web-01' | Select-Object Macro, Value
```

Read the macro first and pipe it in: Get-ZbxUserMacro writes macro objects that Remove-ZbxUserMacro binds. ConfirmImpact is High, so -Confirm:$false skips the prompt.

### Example 2: Delete a macro by its id

```powershell
$macro = Get-ZbxUserMacro -Host 'db-01' | Where-Object Macro -EQ '{$APP.TIMEOUT}'
Remove-ZbxUserMacro -InputObject $macro.HostMacroId -Confirm:$false
```

-InputObject takes the macro's id (HostMacroId) as well as the object.

### Example 3: Delete a macro from every host of a group

```powershell
Get-ZbxHost -Group 'Linux servers' | Get-ZbxUserMacro | Where-Object Macro -EQ '{$APP.TIMEOUT}' | Remove-ZbxUserMacro -WhatIf
Get-ZbxHost -Group 'Linux servers' | Get-ZbxUserMacro | Where-Object Macro -EQ '{$APP.TIMEOUT}' | Remove-ZbxUserMacro -Confirm:$false
```

-WhatIf lists the macros that would go; run it again with -Confirm:$false to delete them.

## PARAMETERS

### -InputObject

The user macro(s) to change or delete: ids, names or objects, from the pipeline or by position. -Id is an alias.

## INPUTS

- `ZabbixReference<ZabbixUserMacro>[]`: Bound to -InputObject (ByValue). Represents a reference to an API object: a parameter that points at an API object takes its id, its name, or the object itself piped from a Get- cmdlet, and becomes an id before the call — one parameter, three spellings, one resolution.
